rate_updates.description: Dated changelog of every TikTok Shop fee change we track, with effective dates, verified dates and source links
rate_updates.description_zh: 按日期记录我们追踪到的每一项 TikTok Shop 费用变化 —— 推荐费率、FBT 费率卡、退款管理费 —— 每条都带生效日期、我们核实的日期，以及官方来源链接。

fee_structure.referral_fee: 6% flat on the buyer's total payment (item price plus any buyer-paid shipping)
fee_structure.transaction_fee: None. TikTok's published commission policy lists no separate per-order transaction fee; the flat 6% referral rate took effect 1 April 2024. The April 2023 date cited on other sites is the start of a 2023 promotion that temporarily cut the old 2% rate to 0% (US).
fee_structure.fbt_fulfillment: $4.28-$12.67 per unit (single-item, by weight, up to 16 lb)
fee_structure.fbt_storage: Per cubic foot PER DAY, by inventory age (rate card effective 2025-12-15): free for the first 60 days, then $0.03 (days 61-90), $0.04 (91-120), $0.06 (121-180), $0.12 (181-270), $0.14 (271-365) and $0.27 beyond 365 days. Billed daily at 23:59 on the total cubic feet of all units, sellable and defective alike; minimum chargeable volume 0.001 cu ft per SKU per day. Guides that quote a flat monthly per-cubic-foot figure omit the age escalation.
fee_structure.creator_commission: seller-set; official range 1-80% (third-party US average ~13%; TikTok publishes no official average)
